steps.name: Show pizza dough
positives: A plain pizza base or dough is clearly visible on a flat surface.
negatives: No pizza base or dough is visible.
Toppings are already on the base.
The scene does not contain a pizza or dough.

steps.name: Add mushrooms
positives: Mushroom slices are visible on top of the pizza base.
negatives: No mushrooms are visible on the pizza.
Only other toppings are visible (but no mushrooms).
The scene does not contain a pizza.

steps.name: Add chilli peppers
positives: Chilli peppers (fresh or sliced) are visible on top of the pizza.
negatives: No chilli peppers are visible on the pizza.
Only other toppings are visible (but no chilli peppers).
The scene does not contain a pizza.
